author: Nintendo of America
description:
Grave Seasons launches this summer 2026 on Nintendo Switch!  

After a treacherous escape from jail, you’ve made it to your new home in Ashenridge, an idyllic town with some seriously unsettling vibes. While trying to establish your new farming life and embed yourself in the neighborhood, murders start to occur in the town, putting your new peaceful life at risk.  

Grave Seasons is a narrative-led farming sim with a terrifying twist—someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer.        

#GraveSeasons #NintendoSwitch

author: Nintendo of America
description:
TOEM 2 is coming to Nintendo Switch in summer 2026! 

Head off on a relaxing 3D adventure, spurred on by your awakened passion for discovering and photographing these mysterious “events” known as TOEMs. Jump and climb your way across the environment to see the world from a whole new perspective. Make your way through new regions, lend a hand to new faces, and create lasting friendships. So, what are you waiting for? There are more TOEMs to discover!
